name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 55 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
